entities.name: Józef Kupny
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Józef Piotr Kupny is a Polish Roman Catholic prelate. He has been archbishop of Wrocław since 2013 and vice president of the Polish Episcopal Conference since 2024. He was previously auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Katowice from 2006 to 2013.
